model: TF-IDF cosine threshold tuned on val split (threshold=0.06)
why_different: Binary threshold sweep; boundary chosen for val-F1. NOT a trained LR classifier. 0.8533 > 0.800 because the tuned threshold exploits class imbalance differently than balanced LR.

model: LogisticRegression on single cosine feature (1-d input)
why_different: LR fits decision boundary on training labels; better than the threshold-tuned version (0.8667 > 0.8533). Neither uses |u-v|.
Adding 3000-d |u-v| to cos HURTS at n=116 training pairs (high-dim noise; LR cannot regularise). 0.800 < 0.8667: absdiff_cos worse than cos_only.

model: LogisticRegression on [|u-v|, cos] -- same model as full_pair_tfidf_lr
why_different: Matches full_pair_tfidf_lr (0.8400 == 0.8400). Cross-check confirms both CSVs use the same frozen pairs file.
